verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export, including scheduled automatic exports (Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export). Exports turn properties into front matter and store collections as CSV, and are described as human- and machine-readable for reuse in other apps. The REST API offers an additional programmatic path for getting content out. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the note file format (Markdown is only implied by the front matter), documentation of how images and media are exported, and independent or hands-on confirmation that full exports are complete.
